purpose_context: This is wave-2 mission M7 of the muster <-> spec-kitty agent-conformance programme. It composes the spec-kitty stack the way it actually deploys -- a persona projected from a built-in agent profile, AGENTS.md as the SOP slot, and one skill -- and runs muster's crosslayer adapter over the stack: static contradiction/precedence lint gated on every PR, live-model rule-survival on cadence. Includes a deterministic profile-to-Soul.md projector (D1's narrow scope) whose fabricated RFC-1 fields are never themselves graded. FR-005's rule-survival cases depend on M3 (MOES-Media/spec-kitty#30) merging first; the rest of the mission does not.
purpose_tldr: Compose persona+SOP+skill the way spec-kitty actually deploys it and gate on cross-layer contradiction/rule-survival.
